name: SLS Barcelona

address.street: Carrer de la Pau 2 Port Forum Barcelona

insider_take: Where Philippe Starck's avant-garde design meets Barcelona's vibrant energy in the heart of Eixample district.
whats_special: This striking tower features the world-renowned designer Philippe Starck's signature whimsical interiors, from Alice in Wonderland-inspired lobby elements to rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic city views. The rooftop terrace provides stunning 360-degree vistas of Barcelona, including Sagrada Familia and the Mediterranean Sea.
pro_tip: Book a sunset drink at the rooftop bar during golden hour – the views of Gaudí's masterpieces bathed in warm light are absolutely magical and perfect for Instagram.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime Eixample location puts you within walking distance of Casa Batlló and Casa Milà, while Passeig de Gràcia's luxury shopping is right at your doorstep. The nearby Diagonal Metro station connects you effortlessly to Barcelona's beaches and Gothic Quarter.
pros: Prime location in Barcelona's vibrant city center with easy access to attractions
Sophisticated contemporary design and stylish modern accommodations
Rooftop pool and terrace with panoramic city views
High-quality dining venues and trendy bar scene
cons: Urban setting may be noisy for light sleepers
